# Code of Conduct

Be respectful and technical. Discuss code, behavior, evidence, and trade-offs without personal attacks or harassment.

Project discussions may involve disputed runtime behavior. Prefer reproducible evidence, exact versions, logs, traces, and minimal examples over assumptions about intent or competence.

Maintainers may remove abusive, discriminatory, threatening, or persistently disruptive content and may restrict participation when necessary to keep the project usable.
